name: x-twitter-scraper
title: X (Twitter) Data Platform
description: Use when the user needs to interact with X (Twitter) — searching tweets, looking up users/followers, posting tweets/replies, liking, retweeting, following/unfollowing, sending DMs, downloading media, monitoring accounts in real time, or extracting bulk data. Provides 121 REST API endpoints, 2 MCP tools, and HMAC webhooks.
